description: A `paramset` (Verilog-AMS LRM 6.4) defines a named set of parameter values for a module. It is outside the Verilog-A language this simulator implements. Until 2.33.0 this was reported as "expected `module`".
actions: Set the values on each instance line instead (`X1 a b r rr=2k`), or give the module the defaults the paramset would have set.
